summary: Nuburu, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a binding Head of Terms with SunCubes S.r.l. for a minority investment of up to €1,000,000 and an industrial cooperation framework. No per-share price or premium is stated because the target is private and the consideration is a fixed cash contribution for a minority stake. The deal is subject to Italian Golden Power clearance and export-control license by December 30, 2026. Board recommendation and advisors are not named. This is a small venture investment, not a transformative M&A or special-situations event; it is routine capital deployment.
